recipe.title: Lemon garlic chicken
recipe.summary: Pan-fried chicken thighs with lemon and garlic.
method: Season the chicken with the salt. Fry in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes each side until cooked through.
Add the garlic for 1 minute, then the lemon juice, and turn the chicken to coat.

note: sound

recipe.title: Quick tomato pasta
recipe.summary: Spaghetti in a garlicky tomato sauce.
method: Cook the pasta in boiling water with the salt for 10 minutes and drain.
Meanwhile, soften the garlic in the oil over low heat for 1 minute, add the passata and simmer for 10 minutes.
Toss the pasta through the sauce and serve with parmesan.

note: sound

recipe.title: Egg fried rice
recipe.summary: Day-old rice fried with egg, peas and spring onion.
method: Scramble the eggs in half the oil over medium heat until just set, then remove.
Fry the rice and peas in the rest of the oil for 5 minutes until hot.
Stir in the egg, spring onion and soy sauce.

note: sound

recipe.title: Red lentil dhal
recipe.summary: Lentils simmered with spices until creamy.
method: Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes, then stir in the curry powder.
Add the lentils and water and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft. Season with the salt.

note: sound

recipe.title: Baked salmon with greens
recipe.summary: Oven-baked salmon with broccolini and lemon.
method: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Put the salmon and broccolini on a tray, drizzle with oil and top with lemon.
Bake for 12 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.

note: sound

recipe.title: Fluffy pancakes
recipe.summary: Fluffy pancakes for a weekend breakfast.
method: Whisk the flour and sugar, then whisk in the eggs, milk and butter until just smooth.
Cook 60 ml of batter per pancake, three or four at a time, in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden.

note: 3 tbsp salt for four bowls of soup

recipe.title: Pumpkin soup
recipe.summary: Smooth roast pumpkin soup.
method: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the pumpkin, stock and salt and simmer for 25 minutes until soft.
Blend until smooth.

note: chicken served pink

recipe.title: Seared chicken breast
recipe.summary: Quick seared chicken with salad.
method: Sear the chicken in the oil for 1 minute each side, leaving it pink in the middle.
Slice and serve on the rocket.

note: cake at 250°C for 2 hours, total 40 minutes

recipe.title: Butter cake
recipe.summary: A simple vanilla butter cake.
method: Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then the eggs one at a time.
Fold in the flour, milk and vanilla.
Bake at 250°C for 2 hours.

note: stock listed but never added to the risotto

recipe.title: Mushroom risotto
recipe.summary: Creamy risotto with mushrooms and parmesan.
method: Soften the onion and mushrooms in the butter for 8 minutes.
Stir in the rice for 1 minute, then cover and cook for 20 minutes.
Stir through the parmesan.

note: 2 cups of rice with 100 ml water

recipe.title: Steamed rice
recipe.summary: Plain fluffy white rice.
method: Rinse the rice, add the water and bring to the boil.
Cover and cook on low for 12 minutes, then rest for 5 minutes.

note: a vegetarian lasagne made with beef

recipe.title: Vegetarian lasagne
recipe.summary: A meat-free lasagne for the whole family.
method: Brown the mince for 8 minutes, then simmer with the passata for 15 minutes.
Layer the sauce, sheets and ricotta three times, top with mozzarella.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes.

note: marinates overnight but says 20 minutes in total

recipe.title: Yoghurt-marinated lamb
recipe.summary: Tender lamb chops in a spiced yoghurt marinade.
method: Mix the yoghurt, cumin and garlic and coat the lamb. Marinate overnight in the fridge.
Grill the lamb for 4 minutes each side until browned.

note: 50 g pasta for six people

recipe.title: Pasta bake
recipe.summary: A cheesy family pasta bake.
method: Cook the pasta for 8 minutes and drain.
Mix with the passata, top with the mozzarella and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes.

note: banana bread baked with a time but no way to tell it's done

recipe.title: Banana bread
recipe.summary: A moist loaf for morning tea.
method: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a loaf tin.
Mix the bananas, sugar, eggs and butter, then fold in the flour.
Pour into the tin and bake for 55 minutes.

note: the sauce is served before it's made

recipe.title: Chicken with mushroom sauce
recipe.summary: Pan-fried chicken with a creamy mushroom sauce.
method: Season the chicken with the salt and fry in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes each side until cooked through.
Spoon the mushroom sauce over the chicken and serve.
Fry the mushrooms in the same pan for 5 minutes, add the cream and simmer for 3 minutes until thick.

note: pork chops with a time but no doneness cue

recipe.title: Pork chops with apple
recipe.summary: Thick pork chops with sweet pan-fried apple.
ingredients: 800 g pork loin, cut into 4 thick steaks
method: Season the pork with the salt and fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 3 minutes each side.
Fry the apples in the butter for 4 minutes until soft and serve with the pork.

note: meatloaf baked with no sign it's cooked through

recipe.title: Meatloaf
recipe.summary: A classic glazed beef meatloaf.
method: Heat the oven to 180°C.
Mix the beef, onion, breadcrumbs and egg and press into a loaf tin.
Spread with the tomato sauce and bake for 25 minutes. Slice and serve.

note: fish fried for one minute with no doneness cue

recipe.title: Lemon butter fish
recipe.summary: Thick white fish in a lemon butter sauce.
method: Season the fish with the salt and fry in the butter over medium heat for 1 minute.
Add the lemon juice, spoon it over the fish and serve.

note: sound

recipe.title: Beef tacos
recipe.summary: Spiced beef mince in soft tortillas.
method: Fry the beef in the oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through.
Stir in the taco seasoning and 60 ml water and simmer for 2 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry frying pan for 20 seconds each side and fill with the beef, lettuce and cheese.

note: sound

recipe.title: Chocolate muffins
recipe.summary: Easy one-bowl chocolate muffins.
method: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Whisk the flour, cocoa and sugar, then stir in the eggs, milk and oil until just combined.
Spoon into the tin and bake for 20 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
